game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the frost mage calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the frost mage calls throughout the level. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the frost mage ahead. Then check the library value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving library that move the frost mage forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
